title: Young Adult Resting State and Auditory Oddball Task EEG Data
description: Resting-state and auditory oddball task EEG recordings from young adults, collected under two conditions: a control condition and an arousal condition induced by threat of unpredictable shock. Recordings include eyes-open and eyes-closed rest, plus passive and active auditory oddball tasks with standard, target, and distractor tones. The dataset supports investigation of arousal and locus coeruleus-noradrenaline system related neural activity.
methods_description: EEG was recorded during 5-minute eyes-open and eyes-closed resting periods and during passive and active auditory oddball tasks. Each session was run under a control condition and a shock-threat arousal condition. Events are coded for task phase, tone type, and manual button responses.
